title: Spelled-out acronym letters never assemble into the acronym
why_real: ASR returned the acronym as three separate spelled letters ('h s r'); assembling three tokens into one needs a 3-to-1 rewrite the system structurally cannot do, so it is an honest, documented ABSTAIN rather than a bug.
